title: Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (General Data Protection Regulation), Article 28
source: Regulation (EU) 2016/679, Article 28(3): what a contract between a controller and a processor sets out.

rules.text: A data processing agreement sets out the subject-matter and duration, the nature and purpose, the types of personal data and categories of data subjects, and the processor's duties (a) to (h): documented instructions, confidentiality, Article 32 security, sub-processors, help with data subjects' rights, help with Articles 32 to 36, deletion or return, and information and audits.
